teamchat.subtitle: Members and agnts in one room: agnts posts cards when work needs a person, links messages to tickets and answers @agnts.
teamchat.channelNameHelp: Lower case letters, digits, - and _ (spaces become -).
teamchat.emptyText: Write the first message. Mention @agnts to ask about tickets, pull requests, CI and findings.
teamchat.sendHint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line · @agnts to ask agnts
teamchat.waiting: {n, plural, one {# message waits} other {# messages wait}}
teamchat.notLoaded: That message is not loaded here. Scroll up to load older messages.
teamchat.statsLine: {links, plural, one {# link} other {# links}} · {answers, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}} · {drafts, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}}
teamchat.mergeText: PR #{number} in {repo} will be merged on the git host.
teamchat.mergeCiRun: CI is still running. Merge anyway?
teamchat.mergeCiRunNames: CI is still running: {checks}. Merge anyway?
teamchat.mergeCiNone: This repository has no CI checks. Merge anyway?
teamchat.reviewFindings: {n, plural, one {# review finding} other {# review findings}}
